name: Shared Light: Lynn Goldsmith at Selby Gardens
venue: Marie Selby Botanical Gardens, Downtown Sarasota Campus
hours_label: Daily 10 AM - 5 PM · $28 adults, $12 ages 5-17, under 4 free
blurb: Last week to see Selby Gardens' indoor and outdoor exhibition of Lynn Goldsmith, the celebrated rock-and-roll and nature photographer whose portraits of Patti Smith, Bruce Springsteen and others hang in the Rock & Roll Hall of Fame. Admission includes the bayfront gardens, conservatory and Michael's on the Bay. $28 adults, $12 ages 5-17, members free.
photo_credit: Photo: Marie Selby Botanical Gardens / Selby.org

name: Natasha, Pierre and The Great Comet of 1812
hours_label: Evenings 7:30 PM, weekend matinees · Tickets from $19
blurb: Dingbat Theatre Project stages the Tony-winning electro-pop opera carved from a slice of Tolstoy's War and Peace, with the company's signature immersive, iconoclastic spin. An intimate black-box production on the South Trail near Gulf Gate. Tickets start at $19; final performances Sept. 13.

name: Overjoyed: A Stevie Wonder Tribute (Monday Night Jazz)
venue: John C. Court Cabaret, Florida Studio Theatre
blurb: Florida Studio Theatre's Monday Night Jazz series brings pianist Richard "Stretch" Bruyn and band to the Court Cabaret downtown for an evening of Stevie Wonder classics, from Superstition to Overjoyed. Cabaret seating with drinks and small plates. Tickets from $18.

name: Sarasota Farmers Market
venue: Downtown Sarasota, Lemon Ave & Main St
blurb: Sarasota's original Saturday ritual since 1979: 70-plus vendors along Lemon Avenue and Main Street with local produce, fresh seafood, baked goods, orchids, coffee and live music. Dog-friendly and walkable to the bayfront. Free to attend, rain or shine.
source: Sarasota Farmers Market / evergreen weekly anchor
